meta.title: The first weight save also locks vendors' quantities (allow_fixed_quantity_for_bidding)
gaps: The happy-path weight save is not expressible because no operation covers the weight-save request and its method, path, and body are not provided.
The trade_config.allow_fixed_quantity_for_bidding field is not available in the read-back fields.
The required screen confirmation is outside the available API vocabulary.
